$comment: Published package versions, verified against the registry by CI on every run.
This file exists because consumers read the repository when they cannot query the
registry, and a repository tag is not a package version. Reading
packages/<name>/package.json at a tag reports the source tree at that moment, not what
is published; that has caused several repositories to report defects fixed releases
earlier. Rather than telling consumers not to read the repository, this file makes the
repository answer correctly, and scripts/check-published-versions.mjs fails CI if it
Safe to read at a tag: the check runs on main, so any commit you can check out had this
file matching the registry at that time. Newer versions may exist; none of the versions
